description_en: Creates a menu tree directory. This operation supports features such as compute nodes, data integration, and synchronization tasks
description_zh: 创建菜单树目录，支持计算任务、数据集成、同步任务等功能
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-directory --op-tenant-id 30001011 --create-command Category=tempCode ProjectId=1212344 Name=test_xx Directory=/ --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDirectory

fields.description_en:
The menu tree category. Valid values:
- tempCode: custom query
- codeManage: code node
- offlinePipeline: offline pipeline
- offlinePipelineCustomPlugin: pipeline custom component
- dataX: synchronization task
- streamMeta: real-time meta table
- streamCustomDataSource: real-time custom source
- streamTemplate: real-time compute template
- resourceManage: resource management
- udfResource: offline function
- streamFunction: real-time function.
fields.description_zh:
菜单树类目
- 即席查询：tempCode
- 代码任务：codeManage
- 离线管道：offlinePipeline
- 管道自定义组件：offlinePipelineCustomPlugin
- 同步任务：dataX
- 实时元表：streamMeta
- 实时自定义源：streamCustomDataSource
- 实时计算模板：streamTemplate
- 资源管理：resourceManage
- 离线函数：udfResource
- 实时函数：streamFunction
